quote: H. Poritsky's paper 'The billiard ball problem on a table with a convex boundary—an illustrative dynamical problem' was published in the Annals of Mathematics in 1950, volume 51, pages 446–470
posed_by: George David Birkhoff (communicated to H. Poritsky)
note: The conjecture was communicated by Birkhoff to his doctoral student H. Poritsky, who conducted the research in 1927–29 while at Harvard University under Birkhoff's supervision. However, the first formal published statement of the conjecture appeared in Poritsky's 1950 Annals of Mathematics paper.
